The diff removes cryptography.fernet.Fernet, cryptography.hazmat.backends.default_backend, and cryptography.hazmat.primitives.hashes from production code, and the dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from repo code. Dynamic target events resolve Crypto to site-packages/Crypto/__init__.py with target_local_spec_count 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake target provider.

diff_text:
--- a/encrypt_decrypt_fields/services/crypto.py
+++ b/encrypt_decrypt_fields/services/crypto.py
@@ -1,8 +1,10 @@
 import base64
+import time
 
-from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
-from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend
-from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes
+from Crypto.Cipher import AES
+from Crypto.Hash import HMAC, SHA256
+from Crypto.Random import get_random_bytes
+from Crypto.Util.Padding import pad, unpad
 
 
 class Crypto:
@@ -10,17 +12,36 @@
         self.key = key
 
     def get_key(self) -> bytes:
-        digest = hashes.Hash(hashes.SHA256(), backend=default_backend())
-        digest.update(self.key.encode())
-        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest.finalize())
+        digest = SHA256.new(self.key.encode()).digest()
+        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest)
+
+    def _split_key(self) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
+        key = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(self.get_key())
+        return key[:16], key[16:]
 
     def encrypt(self, password: str) -> bytes:
-        fernet = Fernet(self.get_key())
-        return fernet.encrypt(password.encode())
+        signing_key, encryption_key = self._split_key()
+        iv = get_random_bytes(16)
+        cipher = AES.new(encryption_key, AES.MODE_CBC, iv=iv)
+        payload = (
+            b"\x80"
+            + int(time.time()).to_bytes(8, "big")
+            + iv
+            + cipher.encrypt(pad(password.encode(), AES.block_size))
+        )
+        signature = HMAC.new(signing_key, payload, digestmod=SHA256).digest()
+        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(payload + signature)
 
     def decrypt_token(self, token: bytes | None) -> str | None:
         if not token:
             return None
 
-        fernet = Fernet(self.get_key())
-        return fernet.decrypt(token).decode()
+        data = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token)
+        signing_key, encryption_key = self._split_key()
+        payload, signature = data[:-32], data[-32:]
+        HMAC.new(signing_key, payload, digestmod=SHA256).verify(signature)
+
+        iv = payload[9:25]
+        ciphertext = payload[25:]
+        cipher = AES.new(encryption_key, AES.MODE_CBC, iv=iv)
+        return unpad(cipher.decrypt(ciphertext), AES.block_size).decode()
